We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: The defendant bought industrial salt (non-food) and sold it as edible salt, i.e., selling food that does not meet safety standards. This is a classic crime: “销售不符合安全标准的食品罪” (selling food that does not meet safety standards). The correction lessons mention that for similar case, correct label is “销售不符合安全标准的食品”. Indeed earlier example: "公诉机关认为，被告人于某君销售不符合安全标准的食品罪". So label should be exactly that.

Check if any other crimes apply: Possibly also “非法经营”? But the facts only mention selling non-food salt as food, which is a specific offense. No mention of other crimes like fraud, etc. So single label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>
